_real_world.variant_scope: AE1107C as fitted to CMV-22B Osprey (optional CVW-8 branch, count 0 in the 2025-26 deployment; twin-engine tiltrotor installation)
public_equipment: 2 x AE1107C, 7,000 shp each (Rolls-Royce official specification)

_provenance.modeling_note: CMV-22B is the optional CVW-8 COD branch (count 0 in the 2025-26 baseline; CVW-8 flew C-2A per the OOB page). AE1107C is a turboshaft driving proprotors, not a thrust-producing jet engine; same schema limitation as the other CSG turboshaft/turboprop records (CSG_US_T700-GE-401C, CSG_US_T56-A-427A, CSG_US_T56-A-425): the loader's Engine block has no shaft-horsepower field, so mil_thrust_n/ab_thrust_n is an engineering_estimate equivalent static thrust from the sourced 7,000 shp rating via the same T[N]~=4.0*shp proxy factor; not a real thrust figure.

engine.mil_thrust_n.note: 7,000 shp sourced from Rolls-Royce official AE 1107C product page; converted via T[N]=4.0*shp proxy factor since the loader has no shp field and this is a proprotor-drive turboshaft, not a thrust engine

engine.ab_thrust_n.note: set equal to mil_thrust_n; turboshaft has no afterburner stage

engine.sfc_mil.note: no public SFC found for AE1107C; proxy from the T700-401C/-701C GE datasheet's Maximum(10-min) SFC figure (0.462 lb/SHP-hr, rounded), a comparable-class modern turboshaft

engine.bypass_ratio.note: 0.0 placeholder; not a meaningful concept for a turboshaft
